'''Vicky Grau Muxella'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Grau|Muxella}} (born 8 April 1975) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. She competed at the [[1992 Winter Olympics|1992]], [[1994 Winter Olympics|1994]], [[1998 Winter Olympics|1998]] and the [[2002 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gr/vicky-grau-1.html |title=Vicky Grau |access-date=27 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203065134/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gr/vicky-grau-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Vicky Grau Muxella}}</ref>

She is the sister of alpine skier [[Sandra Grau]].<ref name="SportsRef" />
